title: Shouldn't be called a rug.
text:
Shouldn't be called a rug.. too thin to call it a rug and if you have wood or tile floors you will slip. You can fix the slipping issue by buying non skid tape. I wouldn't put this in a high traffic area due to the thinness of the rug.
I'm not sending this back because I bought it on lighting deal so I didn't pay too much for it. It is going into my bedroom next to my bed. I did order a larger one at the same time. That is also going in my bedroom in the sitting/tv area.
